## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. Explain skipped checks and distinguish automated tests from live Discord/provider testing.

## Configuration or migration

Describe any new optional settings, data/schema changes or deployment steps. Write "None" when unnecessary.

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant regression coverage or explains why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] Affected documentation and generated catalogs are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Current authorization, isolation, consent, cancellation and resource limits remain enforced.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, private conversations, voice recordings, local databases, backups or runtime logs.

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md and coordinate privately before opening a public pull request with exploit details.
